name: Release image: one Docker Hub repo, pinnable v* tag, real build provenance
description:
We run the hosted deployment of codx-junior (codx-junior-website, server/services/installScript.js). Our installer PULLS the product image instead of compiling it on the customer's box, then verifies the published port. .github/workflows/release.yml is exactly what that needs — but the published artifacts sit in TWO Docker Hub repositories and the stale one is what a fresh install used to get. We already switched our default to codxjuniorai/codx-junior (verified), so nothing on our side is blocked; the asks below are about the artifact being trustworthy for every installer.

EVIDENCE (measured 2026-11-22, not read from docs)

1) codxjuniorai/codxjuniorai — stale and 3x bigger
- tags latest, 0.0.1, v0.0.1 all point to the SAME digest sha256:822c8bd8ad77, created 2026-11-19T16:23Z
- 4.0 GB compressed, 15.3 GB unpacked, amd64 only
- main is at 673c705 (2026-11-21), so that image is >= 7 commits behind: ticketing module + company-first shell (67c2eea), chat index/blob store (ad7277a), tab-switch tests and image env parsing (cdaa7e7), effort tiers (dffdfe6), meetings/tasks API + kanban boards (b24ece8), CISO gate (361e2c1, 1aa9846)

2) codxjuniorai/codx-junior — the real release channel, and fresh
- latest pushed 2026-11-22T12:32Z, digest sha256:ed81d49bf754, 1.6 GB compressed / 4.72 GB unpacked
- pulled and ran it: GET :19981/api/health -> 200 {"status":"ok"}, workspace_api.contract_version: 1
- content check inside the image: api/codx/junior/ticketing/ and api/codx/junior/api/tickets.py are present -> it includes the 2026-11-21 work

3) Provenance is broken in the published image
- release.yml passes CODX_JUNIOR_BUILD_VERSION/REF/COMMIT and codx-junior-installer/demo/Dockerfile honours them (ARG+ENV :113-118, written :124)
- inside the running codx-junior:latest container: printenv CODX_JUNIOR_BUILD_VERSION -> unknown, CODX_JUNIOR_BUILD_COMMIT -> unknown
- GET /api/health -> {"version":"unknown","ref":"unknown","commit":"unknown"}
- so a deployment cannot assert which code it runs — precisely what the workflow comment says health is for. It also means we cannot detect a customer box stuck on an old build.

4) No pinnable release tag
- tags in codxjuniorai/codx-junior: latest, dind, dind-2026-11-20, login-test -> none matches v*.*.*
- so install.sh --ref vX.Y.Z -> image :vX.Y.Z has no valid value today, and our CODX_JUNIOR_IMAGE_TAG has nothing to pin

5) Already fixed — thank you
.dockerignore no longer carries **/analytics/ (explanatory comment at :97-101). That was our "exit 17" blocker and it is resolved on main.

WHAT WE ASK

A. One repository (highest value). Stop publishing to codxjuniorai/codxjuniorai: delete it, or keep it only as a retag of the same digest as codx-junior, and point the install docs at codxjuniorai/codx-junior. Two repos with very different images is how a customer lands on a 6-day-old 15 GB build.

B. Cut the first pinnable release. Push a v*.*.* tag so release.yml publishes codxjuniorai/codx-junior:vX.Y.Z, and use that tag in the docs example. We will pin instead of latest.

C. Make provenance real. Find why the build-args never reached a latest built today, and add a guard to release.yml BEFORE the push: fail the job when the smoke container reports version: unknown. An image published without provenance is accepted by every pipeline, ours included.

D. (informational) amd64 only — fine for us; say if arm64 is on the roadmap so we can document instance requirements.

ACCEPTANCE
- docker run --rm -p 19981:19981 codxjuniorai/codx-junior:vX.Y.Z -> /api/health returns version: X.Y.Z, ref: vX.Y.Z, commit: <12-char sha> (not "unknown")
- codxjuniorai/codxjuniorai deleted or clearly deprecated with no tag newer than its archive date; documentation references a single repository
- release.yml fails the release when the smoke test sees unknown provenance

OUR SIDE (already done, for reference)
server/services/installScript.js
- DEFAULT_IMAGE_REPO is now codxjuniorai/codx-junior (was codxjuniorai/codxjuniorai), with the reason documented above the constant
- verified: imageRef() -> codxjuniorai/codx-junior:latest, generated wrapper contains 0 references to the stale repository
- the pull stays FATAL: a missing image fails the install instead of compiling the product on a 2 vCPU box

Evidence upgrade — read straight from the registry config blobs (no pull, `tmp/dockerhub-provenance.mjs`, 2026-11-22T16:5xZ). This is bake-time truth, not a runtime printenv:

codxjuniorai/codx-junior:latest
  config digest sha256:64dd6ae8962f…, created 2026-11-22T12:26:54Z
  CODX_JUNIOR_BUILD_VERSION=unknown · CODX_JUNIOR_BUILD_REF=unknown · CODX_JUNIOR_BUILD_COMMIT=unknown

codxjuniorai/codxjuniorai:latest
  config digest sha256:aee686e8107e…, created 2026-11-19T16:14:00Z
  CODX_JUNIOR_BUILD_VERSION=0.0.1 · CODX_JUNIOR_BUILD_REF=v0.0.1-1-gdba24f4 · CODX_JUNIOR_BUILD_COMMIT=dba24f4bf27c3b139ff4c8f890630ce090957f45

So the irony is exact and worth fixing in that order: the OLD repository's image still carries correct provenance while today's NEW one carries `unknown`. The release pipeline publishing to codxjuniorai/codx-junior is dropping the build-args (a tagless checkout would also explain it — `git describe` has nothing to describe while no `v*` tag exists). Both symptoms are the same root cause as ask B/C.

Also note the runtime side, from a workspace we provisioned: GET https://e2e-live-1122.codx-junior.ai/api/health →
{"status":"ok","version":"0.0.1","ref":"v0.0.1-1-gdba24f4","commit":"dba24f4…"} — that box predates our switch, so it runs the old repository's image, and the field format is exactly what we need. Nothing to change in the contract: only make the new repo produce the same values.

No action needed from you on our side: our installer already pulls codxjuniorai/codx-junior and pins via CODX_JUNIOR_IMAGE_TAG, which becomes useful the moment a v* tag exists.
